preconditions.description: N is a positive integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly 2^(N-1) valid N-bit binary strings.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == N for s in NBitBinary(N))
postconditions.description: Each string in the output has exactly N characters.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(s[i]) >= int(s[j]) for i in range(k) for j in range(k) if i < j) for s in NBitBinary(N) for k in range(1, N))
postconditions.description: For every prefix of length k in each string, the number of 1's is greater than or equal to the number of 0's.
Every string in the output starts with '1'.
The output list is in strictly decreasing lexicographical order.
